invented.quote: Each book also takes me about four months of full-time work.
invented.why: The brief says each book takes about four months, but does not say that this is full-time work.

invented.quote: My fees elsewhere have gone up as well.
invented.why: The brief only gives a single fee from one other publisher last year and does not state that the writer's fees at other publishers have increased over time.

invented.quote: Last year another publisher paid me $12,500 for a 32-page book of the same scope.
invented.why: The brief states the other publisher's book was of the 'same length' (32 pages), not that it had the 'same scope' (such as 14 full spreads).
